ValidationRule.description: Prevents editing Course Checklist Item when Status is Completed, except for System Administrator profile.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Completed"), ISPICKVAL(Checklist_Item_Type__c, "Zoho Tasks"), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Completed records cannot be edited except by System Administrator.
